title: Ruth Stays With Naomi Through Her Grief
summary_text: Famine takes Naomi's family to Moab, where her husband and both sons die. Hearing that the LORD has provided food for His people, Naomi heads home and urges her daughters-in-law to return to their families, asking Him to show them loving devotion. Orpah leaves, but Ruth refuses to part from Naomi and commits herself to Naomi's people and God for life. When they reach Bethlehem, Naomi asks to be called Mara because she believes the Almighty has made her life bitter. They arrive as the barley harvest begins.

title: Boaz Protects Ruth in His Fields
summary_text: Ruth goes to gather leftover grain and happens to work in the field of Boaz, a relative of Naomi's husband. title: Ruth Asks Boaz to Be Her Redeemer
summary_text: Seeking a secure home for Ruth, Naomi tells her to go to Boaz at the threshing floor and lie at his uncovered feet.
